control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
positive communication before approaching mobile equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: unplanned release of kinetic energy at HT-9002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment on HT-9002 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically managing light-vehicle and haul-truck interaction. HT-9002 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 16 March 2013 a hazard report was recorded on HT-9002 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during cleaning and preparation; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
